bureau: Mala'a (Oman Credit and Financial Information Centre)
note: Bank Dhofar's guide to Mala'a: an individual's credit report covers credit contracts over the previous 24 months, written as two years. The Central Bank of Oman's Mala'a page (read after completing its certificate chain from DigiCert's AIA copy) states no period, so the bank's guide is registered as secondary. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Bank Dhofar, Do you know your rights as a Mala'a customer?
sources.said: Mala’a Credit Report for individuals consists of comprehensive information on their credit contracts over the previous 24 months.
